Quick update on autoscaler root cause:
- What happened: a recent policy merge (PR #3412) inadvertently changed the threshold used by the spot fallback hook. The autoscaler attempted to drain and reschedule during a transient I/O lag and the fallback threshold was higher than expected, which delayed the failover path.
- Immediate remediation: rolling back the merge restores previous thresholds; I propose a targeted rollback now and a follow-up patch to add a canary flag for the fallback threshold.
- ETA: rollback in 2 hours (12:45 PT), full patch by EOD.
- Impact mitigation: we captured traces and will add an ops annotation to the incident log for the QBR appendix.
